generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Fishing boat operation (渔船海上作业). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Photograph the stern work area of a small fishing vessel on a calm grey sea, as if between active hauls. Put the hydraulic winch high in the middle with one bundled net resting securely beside it. Keep the stainless sorting table empty and clean, with the measuring board visible along its edge and a closed iced catch box below. Hang the yellow oilskin jacket and rubber gloves on separate hooks against the wheelhouse wall; coil the washdown hose low on deck and place the portable lamp on a protected shelf. Show enough of the vessel to establish context, with one crew member walking away in the background. No struggling fish, blood, active net deployment, heavy weather, readable vessel text, loose cables or duplicated workwear.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: stern-working fishing vessel, hydraulic net winch, bundled fishing net, stainless catch-sorting table, iced catch box, yellow oilskin jacket, rubber deck gloves, fish measuring board, deck washdown hose, portable marine deck lamp.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
